rows.evaluation_data: Submit either: 1. Diabetes or Hyperglycemia on Oral Medications Status Report (The treating physician must clearly indicate the reason for the medication and if there is any history of diabetes.) OR 2. A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note from the treating physician which contains all the required information listed in the above status report. - It must include the indication for the medication and if there is any history of diabetes or not; - Hemoglobin A1c lab performed no more than 90 days before the AME exam.
rows.evaluation_data_html:
Submit either:

1. Diabetes or Hyperglycemia on Oral Medications Status Report

(The treating physician must clearly indicate the reason for the medication and if there is any history of diabetes.)

OR

2. A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note from the treating physician which contains all the required information listed in the above status report.

  • It must include the indication for the medication and if there is any history of diabetes or not;
  • Hemoglobin A1c lab performed no more than 90 days before the AME exam.
